title: Advanced LangGraph & Agent Patterns
key_concepts: Time travel: rewinding graph state to a previous checkpoint
Supervisor agent pattern: LLM-driven dynamic routing
Parallel node execution: running branches simultaneously
expected_skills: Add persistence to a LangGraph agent with a checkpointer

Build a supervisor agent that dynamically routes to specialist sub-agents

sample_questions: How does LangGraph's checkpointing system enable persistence across agent runs?
